exposure: pulmonary artery acceleration time to right ventricle ejection time ratio
cohort: The study included 26 extremely premature infants (<29 weeks gestational age) with pulmonary hypertension and 52 matched controls without pulmonary hypertension.
finding: Pulmonary artery acceleration time to right ventricle ejection time ratio and eccentricity index measured by echocardiography between 7-21 days of life were predictive of later development of pulmonary hypertension.
followup_time: not specified, but echocardiograms were done at 7-21 days of life
